blocks.text: This department organises welfare support and gathers the church's available resources to provide for those in need.

items: Organising funds and other resources to meet needs within the church.
Identifying individuals who need material assistance and organising support for them.
Supporting the Pastorate in caring for the poor, widows, and needy within the church.
Generosity - a large heart, ready to give to help others.
A love for others - genuinely willing to help.
A sense of concern - without this, little headway is possible in this department.
Confidentiality - a worker here will regularly have access to sensitive, private information and must be trusted to keep it that way.
